pure-announcement.rationale: This is Google's own launch post for Gemini Embedding 2 ('Today we're releasing... in Public Preview') built around availability, partner testimonials and getting-started links; the one transferable technique it names (Matryoshka Representation Learning) gets a single passing sentence, not coverage.

duplicate.rationale: None of the supplied nearest concepts (RAG, context layer, graph-vs-vector retrieval) covers multimodal embedding models, so a reader of the existing corpus would still learn something here.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The claims come from the primary vendor source and are checkable against the public API and its documentation, even if the benchmark framing is vendor-favourable.

durability.rationale: Its substance is preview-stage specifics — per-modality caps (6 images, 120 s video, 6-page PDFs), recommended output dimensions and launch-partner quotes — exactly the details that churn with the next model revision.

actionability.rationale: The only action offered is product-only: call the gemini-embedding-2-preview model through the Gemini or Vertex API using the provided snippet.

atomicity.rationale: The core claim — one model embeds text, images, video, audio and documents into a single space with MRL-scalable dimensions — fits in one paragraph.
